7.0.4 Enabling/Disabling High Availability on a Node
A node that has the high availability flag enabled will be protected against hardware failure at the
zone level. In the event of an unplanned outage, the system will try to immediately transfer your node
to available hardware so that it may continue operating with the least amount of downtime.
As long as a node is not in the creating, updating, removing, failed, or error states, users can enable
HA on it whenever users want. As soon as the success message is received, the setting will go into
effect.
This can be accessed via an action drop-down menu on already-existing nodes or as a toggle during
the node creation process.
Figure: Enabling Node HA
If users enable this, a transaction indicating that HA has been enabled for this node will be generated.
As long as a node is not in the creating, updating, removing, failing, or error states, users can also
disable HA on it whenever users like. As soon as the success message is received, the setting will go
into effect.
